AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.description: DevOps engineer with 2+ years of experience delivering and operating containerized workloads on AWS (ECS Fargate, EKS). I was the primary infrastructure owner for a multi-clinic AWS platform with per-clinic environments — 151 Terraform resources across 22 modules, rolling container rollouts, gated database migrations, and scheduled scaling that cut dev compute hours by ~64%. I build GitHub Actions pipelines, have maintained Jenkins, and support releases of an LLM-backed AI service on EKS (Argo CD, Helm).

ExperienceSection.title: Work Journey
ExperienceSection.description: DevOps, infrastructure and release work across client and SaaS products.

bullets: Deliver DevOps and infrastructure work across three products — primary owner of the infrastructure and delivery pipelines for a multi-clinic booking client platform, and supporting the release and environment needs of Kotae (Tokyo Techies' AI chatbot SaaS, on secondment) and StarLive (real-time streaming, multi-vendor client project) in teams of 5–15, working directly with overseas product owners in English.

Built delivery pipelines in GitHub Actions and maintained existing Jenkinsfile pipelines in Jenkins; on StarLive, migrated the admin app to a Turborepo monorepo, optimized the Docker build with BuildKit cache mounts, standardized on Node 24, and added SonarQube to CI.
Closed the gap between local, CI, and production environments on the clinic-booking platform — replacing MinIO with LocalStack so tests exercise the same S3 API as the deployed service.
Wrote Bash automation for deployment, migration, and environment-provisioning tasks.
Wrote the Terraform README and new-clinic onboarding guide for provisioning each client environment.
Built Gitman, an internal Git repository management tool, with the intern team from the first commit through to company-wide release — Vue.js and TypeScript interface over a Nest.js and MongoDB API.

Shipped Vue 3 and TypeScript workflow features into the production HRM platform used across the company, then moved onto the Kotae product (on secondment to Tokyo Techies) in the final months of the internship and was promoted to Software Engineer after nine months.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Infrastructure and delivery work from client, SaaS and personal projects: context, ownership and what shipped.

ercBooking.title: ERC Booking System
ercBooking.summary: Clinic scheduling platform architected for per-tenant isolation; primary owner of its infrastructure and CI/CD.
bullets: Primary owner of the Terraform codebase (151 resources, 22 reusable modules): authored the bastion, migration-task, work-hours scaling, GitHub Actions IAM, Route 53, S3 frontend, and SES SMTP modules, plus a per-clinic template that gives each clinic a dedicated production environment.
Locked the ALB behind CloudFront + WAF and served private S3 media via OAC + signed URLs; cut dev compute hours by ~64% with work-hours ECS scaling (60 of 168 hours a week) and no NAT gateway.

Built the GitHub Actions rollout pipeline: patched ECS task definitions, rolling API/worker deploys (100% minimum healthy), old-revision cleanup, path-based selective builds, and an S3 + CloudFront frontend release with immutable hashed assets.
Engineered a branch-gated Liquibase migration pipeline that runs as a one-off ECS Fargate task per environment and auto-generates CloudWatch Logs links for failure triage.

kotae.title: Kotae
kotae.team: Tokyo Techies (sister company, on secondment) · team of 14
kotae.summary: AI customer-support chatbot for small businesses: RAG over customer knowledge bases, run on EKS.
bullets: Shipped 21 development deployments across the frontend, backend, and landing services (Nov. 2024 – Jan. 2026) through the team's GitHub Actions to Argo CD + Helm pipeline on EKS.
Diagnosed crawler failures on the development cluster from worker-pod logs (navigation timeouts across concurrent pods) and raised the crawler's navigation timeout.

Prototyped a self-hosted Firecrawl stack in Docker Compose (6 services incl. Playwright, Redis, RabbitMQ) with memory limits, health checks, and profiles, and cut crawler concurrency from 10 to 3 pages.
Extended RAG website ingestion with sitemap.xml URL discovery and feature-flagged OCR of text in crawled images.
Hardened RAG ingestion against SSRF with private-IP and redirect checks around the crawler.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Platform
portfolio.role: Sole engineer — infrastructure, GitOps, release pipeline and application
portfolio.summary: Personal site live since Sep 2025, moved from a self-hosted VPS to a single-node EKS cluster behind Cloudflare in 2026 (not HA; scheduled off nights and Sundays for cost), built across three public repositories.
bullets: Provisioned AWS and Cloudflare in Terraform (67 resource blocks, 6 modules): VPC, EKS with a private API via Session Manager, Pod Identity, ECR, and a Cloudflare-only security group for the controller-managed ALB; CI runs TFLint and Trivy, with actions pinned by SHA.
Ran the cluster as GitOps: Argo CD ApplicationSets deploy 5 Helm charts (Argo CD, Load Balancer Controller, External Secrets, Prometheus, the app with an HPA), validated with kubeconform.

Automated releases in GitHub Actions: OIDC to AWS, approval-gated SHA-tagged images in ECR, the tag committed to GitOps, then a version check and smoke test, restoring the last verified tag on failure.

Shipped 119 filtered Prometheus metrics to 18 upstream Grafana Cloud dashboards, with CloudWatch node-down and scheduler-error alarms — the night-shutdown scheduler (EventBridge + a Python Lambda reconciling every 15 minutes) halves node uptime (84 of 168 hours a week).
Wrote 19 ADRs and 7 runbooks, kept in a private workspace repository (available on request).
